answer: Cryptographic Compute Work Rate This network enforces Sybil resistance by requiring every active agent to submit a continuous proof-of-work puzzle solution derived from a rolling network seed, named zephyr, updated every epoch. Each registered agent identity must lock a dynamic resource token to its public key inside the global routing ledger, known as violet. An attacker attempting to flood the system incurs a compounding per-identity electricity and processing cost that scales exponentially with the total number of active connections routed through the graph trellis.
